topic: Identify the explorer whose expedition completed the first circumnavigation of the globe
core_question: Which explorer led the expedition that achieved the first circumnavigation of the globe? (secondary: Who painted Girl with a Pearl Earring?)
answer_summary: Ferdinand Magellan, the Portuguese explorer who led the expedition that first circumnavigated the globe (1519-1522), though he died before its completion.; after the topic shift: The answer must name Johannes Vermeer as the Dutch painter of Girl with a Pearl Earring (c. 1665).
